name: Metamagic Rod, Blissful
body:
Price varies; Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Lesser blissful metamagic rod 3,000 gp; Blissful metamagic rod 11,000 gp; Greater blissful metamagic rod 24,500 gp; Aura strong (no school)

The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that enliven or pacify targets as though using the Blissful Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: Lesser blissful metamagic rod 1,500 gp; Blissful metamagic rod 5,500 gp; Greater blissful metamagic rod 12,250 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Blissful Spell*
